## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive Scale
where: ScaleRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A is a hive scale: a device stored as a ScaleRecord in ScaleRepository ("private readonly items = new Map<string, ScaleRecord>();"). ScaleService uses it through linkScale, recordReading and sendAlert, so it is a weighing device that gets linked to a hive. B is the beehive itself, which ReportService loops over with HiveRepository.findAll ("for (const hive of this.hives.findAll()) {") and which harvests and treatments are looked up by. A scale is linked to a hive but is a separate real-world thing, so these are related concepts, not one concept under two names.
